display_name: DURA 四阶统计与真实模拟信道变化保持源训练
description: 固定 DURA 和大容量统计条件恢复器，源模拟器信道生成同记录人工扰动，训练变化保持；部署只读单条接收 IQ。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU4 deterministic FP32 TF32off; F frozen CPU for separate source smoke and ground scoring

data.version: fixed source training cache epochs21/22/23; source diagnostic epoch19
data.representation: Paired source received/clean, frozen DURA context, matched source simulator action for source-only perturbation training
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Source-only 64-record real-DURA optimizer smoke and 112-source-record frozen-reader preflight; no target

permissions.claim_scope: F-free/TX-label-free paired source IQ training; F used only in separate source no-query preflight and frozen ground evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only DURA plus independently initialized 14966274-parameter cumulant-conditioned model; no candidate checkpoint inheritance
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed source context cache validated for 32768 legal L_s/U_s source fit IDs and epochs21/22/23; frozen DURA original provenance; no F/TX/V/target in G training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen source-only DURA and matching source cache; new recovery network initialized independently; frozen F only separate source no-query smoke and final evaluation
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed epoch20; no target or source-score checkpoint selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU4, one this-task GPU worker, >=8192 MiB free, fewer than three total compute apps; preserve all other owners; source paired diagnostic gets resource priority
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner on source role or contract mismatch, nonfinite output, wrong checkpoint, target or F/TX leakage, output collision, failed source no-query smoke, or systemic technical failure; preserve other owners and artifacts.

metric_names: true simulator action synthetic response loss

rows.method: Same width384 eight-layer cumulant context model and seed as baseline; source IQ + .02 DURA change + .1 matched moments + .01 response preservation under matched true simulated action
rows.purpose: Train only on authorized source paired IQ; no F/TX/V/target input
rows.seed_notes: Model seed 2026110901; source fit 2026110611; training order 2026110902; evaluation 2026092701.
rows.budget_ref: 14966274 trainable + 266951 frozen DURA; 32768 legal source IDs x 3 views x 20 epochs, batch32

notes: Fixed source simulator action is privileged only for source perturbation training, never an inference input; artificial directions are not verified TX identity.
Training reads no TX labels, F weights/outputs, V or target; frozen F is used only in separate source no-query smoke and fixed seven-view ground evaluation.
The estimated-vs-true action source diagnostic motivated this branch; no target score, labels, or test feedback select its architecture or parameters.
Source fit is the same 32768 IDs and 3 fixed views as cumulant baseline; fixed final epoch20; seven complete predictions precede independent truth-last.
